assign.title: The owner's computer fans are running louder than normal. Find out why. We've had problems before with zombie/orphaned p

log.msg: system_health: two python processes at ~99% of a core each (47776 under the VS Code Claude session 42428, 32556 in the dev-servers group) plus node 47080 (Servex group) at ~40%. Only 1 agent working (me). Inspecting the OS process list next.

Verdict: real problem. Two hung `python -` processes each burn one full core, steady across two 10 s samples. PID 32556 (started 2026-10-28 00:33, 389,735 CPU-s, about 108 h at 100%): its bash parents 36876<-12816<-46816 and the root 29304 are gone, so it is orphaned. Its command came from a Claude Bash call in core/Session/tasks/data-shapes/seats/items. PID 47776 (started 2026-11-01 13:36): its parents are bash 7876<-41968<-5072 and the live VS Code Claude tab 42428. Its command came from a Claude Bash call in ai2-retire running `python - <<EOF ... || sed`. Both are the same pattern: python reads stdin from a heredoc and spins instead of exiting.

Minor findings, no CPU cost: orphan bash 30924 has run an `until grep verdict vs-review.out; do sleep 5` loop since 10-25 that will never end. Orphan bash 27376 (Tunnel.mjs up, 10-20) and orphan bash 9980/32204 with node 29932/26152 (throwaway static servers on 8391/8393, 10-22) are leftovers. Agents: only minion-fan-check is working, 4 dormant, 0 idle holding claude. Memory: 3.8 GB free, commit 55.4 of 59.5 GB; 55 server.js dev servers use about 1.6 GB. Node spikes (AIIndex --watch, health-supervisor, qf-4 run.js) were transient. Nothing killed.

finish.outcome: The fans are loud because two hung `python -` processes each burn one full core. PID 32556 is an orphan that has run since 10-28. PID 47776 sits under the live VS Code tab 42428 and has run since 13:36 today. Both are safe to kill. Agents are not the cause: only this check is working. Nothing was killed; the detail is in the log lines above.
